svg.aria-label: Every Homestead node is a house with the network in its gable, apps and VMs and Longhorn data in its rooms and the host as its foundation; three houses share one VIP and keep three copies of every volume
svg.title: Every Homestead node is a house with the network in its gable, apps and VMs and Longhorn data in its rooms and the host as its foundation; three houses share one VIP and keep three copies of every volume
svg.text: the VIP moves next door, apps restart there, and every volume still has two copies
